name: google-maps-lead-harvester
description: High-volume open-source Google Maps lead scraper with 2-stage discovery engine, stealth anti-bot bypass, background email crawler, and interactive React UI.

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.install:all: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && python -m playwright install chromium && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.install:python: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && python -m playwright install chromium
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "python app.py" "cd frontend && npm run dev"

author: Open Source Community
